name: Leak
source: Childhood friend of Marguerite. She and the protagonist attend adventure school together. During a training mission gone horribly wrong due to Marguerite's reckless actions, both she and the protagonist ended up cursed. Due to this, they have to travel to find a way to lift the curse off of them.
